definitions.explanation: the side that is to the left when facing forward

examples.japanese: {左側|ひだりがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please walk on the left side.
The station is on the left side of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{左側|ひだりがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: In Japan, cars are supposed to drive on the left side of the road.

notes:
A straightforward compound of ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧ (left) and ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Used for spatial orientation, giving directions, and describing positions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左側|ひだりがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧: to turn to the left side
- {左側|ひだりがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass on the left
- {左側通行|ひだりがわつうこう}: left-side traffic
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{左側|ひだりがわ}: the left side of the road

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧: right side — the opposite direction
- ⟦{左手|ひだりて}→左手：10975_hidarite⟧: left hand; can also mean "on one's left"
- ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧: left — the basic directional word without specifying "side"
